message: Every event must have a unique event_id and origin item ID, including owner_escalation. Include type, target where applicable, and impact_file for claim changes. If an earlier event omitted event_id, append a corrected event with a unique ID; do not overwrite the original. Continue one-item-at-a-time review.
Routed to shard05; keep your current item U-P if its proof still depends on this unresolved supplier.
